tr.ts_intro: Hedeflenen güce ulaşmak için kaç seri (ℓ), seri başına kaç birim (n) ve kaç evre (m) gerekir? Aday tasarımların gücü ve tip I hatası R’de hesaplanır; seçim FSR-TN-PBE-01 Tablo 11.3a ve 11.3b’nin kurallarıyla yapılır.

tr.ts_grid_title: Aday tasarımlar: güç ve tip I hata
tr.ts_layer_betik: Bu aday küme için hazır sonuç yok ve toplam iş tarayıcı sınırının üstünde. Aday kümeyi daraltın ya da tasarım betiğini kullanın (T-3, yakında).
tr.ts_st_hazir: Hazır sonuç (veri tabanı); kurallar R’de uygulandı.
tr.ts_st_cancelled: İptal edildi; tablo tamamlanmadı, seçim yapılmadı.
tr.ts_t1_at: tip I hata FDA δ₀ ve EMA 1,18’de

tr.ts_why_guc_yetersiz: aday kümede hedef güce ulaşan tasarım yok
tr.ts_why_tip1_kalibrasyon: güç yeterli, ama tip I hata nominali aşıyor
tr.ts_why_tip1_hesaplanamadi: tip I hata hesaplanamadı (FDA δ₀ tanımsız)

tr.ts_w_near: Bazı seçimler hedefe 2 MCSE’den yakın; hedefin sağlandığı kesin değil (KK-39). Daha çok tekrarla yeniden koşmak gerekir.
tr.ts_legend: Hücre: güç % (kalın), ± MCSE (yp), I = aynı tasarımın tip I hatası %; ! nominali aşıyor, † ayırt edilemiyor (KK-38). Yeşil: hedefe ulaşıyor; kesikli çerçeve: eşiğe yakın; A, B: seçilen tasarım.
tr.code_candidate_list: {f} değerleri farklı ve tam sayı olmalı (ℓ, n ≥ 2; m ≥ 1).
tr.code_power_difference: Güç için gerçek fark geçerli değil ya da bu σR ve ρ için tanımsız.
tr.code_q_needs_m2: q > 0 iken her aday m en az 2 olmalı.

en.subtitle: Simulation of FDA PBE (PSG 020929) and EMA OIP (Rev. 2, 5.1 criterion 8) · results named by hypothesis state
en.disclaimer: For research and education; not a system validated for GxP environments.

en.nsim_max_design: Browser nsim limit for this design
en.layer_hazir: Source: precomputed result (database; no webR needed).
en.layer_canli: Source: live run (webR in the browser).
en.layer_betik: Above the browser limit and no precomputed result: download the R script and run it in your own R.
en.hyp_wait: Getting the hypothesis state from R…
en.st_blocked: Blocked: an engine file could not be verified.
en.st_export_error: The R script could not be produced.
en.go_script: This run is above the browser limit: download it with the “R script” button and run it in your own R.
en.warn_power: Power is not compared between methods unless the nominal type I error is preserved.
en.warn_near: The true difference is very close to a hypothesis boundary (|δ − δboundary| ≤ 10⁻⁴); the class is numerically sensitive.

en.warn_db_db_hash_mismatch: The database failed its SHA-256 check; the precomputed tier is off, live runs only.

en.ver_diff: This link was made with CNKfarmastatr {link}; the site has {site}. The result is not silently converted. If you continue, the result shown or run belongs to {site} and is labelled so.
en.ts_intro: How many batches (ℓ), units per batch (n) and life stages (m) are needed to reach the target power? Power and type I error of the candidate designs are computed in R; the selection follows the rules of FSR-TN-PBE-01 Tables 11.3a and 11.3b.
en.ts_t1_note: Type I error at each method’s own boundary: FDA δ₀, EMA GMR 1.18.
en.ts_cand_note: Every ℓ × n × m combination is a candidate design; the search is limited to this set.
en.ts_grid_title: Candidate designs: power and type I error
en.ts_st_plan: Getting the run plan from R…
en.ts_err_hedef: The target power must be between 0 and 100.
en.ts_layer_betik: No precomputed result for this candidate set and the total work is above the browser limit. Narrow the candidate set or use the design script (T-3, coming).
en.ts_st_hazir: Precomputed result (database); rules applied in R.
en.ts_st_cancelled: Cancelled; the table is incomplete and no selection was made.
en.ts_t1_at: type I error at FDA δ₀ and EMA 1.18
en.ts_rule_B: B · ℓ ≥ 3, n ≥ 10, type I error not above nominal (Table 11.3b)
en.ts_why_sinif_h1_degil: the method is not in H1 at this difference; the rate is not power
en.ts_why_guc_yetersiz: no candidate design reaches the target power
en.ts_why_tip1_kalibrasyon: power is sufficient, but the type I error exceeds the nominal level
en.ts_why_tip1_hesaplanamadi: type I error could not be computed (FDA δ₀ undefined)
en.ts_w_cand: The selection is limited to the given candidate set.
en.ts_w_delta0: FDA δ₀ is not defined for this σR and ρ: no FDA type I error; rule B cannot be applied to FDA.
en.ts_w_h1: Methods not in H1 at this power difference (no selection):
en.ts_w_near: Some selections are within 2 MCSE of the target; meeting the target is not certain (KK-39). Re-run with more replicates.
en.ts_legend: Cell: power % (bold), ± MCSE (pp), I = type I error % of the same design; ! exceeds nominal, † indistinguishable (KK-38). Green: reaches the target; dashed frame: near the target; A, B: selected design.
en.code_candidate_list: {f} values must be distinct whole numbers (ℓ, n ≥ 2; m ≥ 1).
en.code_power_difference: The true difference for power is not valid or not defined for this σR and ρ.
en.code_q_needs_m2: With q > 0 every candidate m must be at least 2.
